_description: Model parameters — values that define the Holistic Universe Model theory. Changing any value = different model. Source of truth for both tools/lib/constants.js and src/script.js.

foundational._retiredInputsNote: Plan 09 step 7c: the frozen era device's inputs left this block — holisticyearLength (the fitted unit, 335,317 yr), stepYears (its lattice grid) and inputmeanlengthsolaryearindays (the device's rounded mean tropical year, 365.2422 d; the J2000 tropical year is DERIVED from the IAU sidereal year and p_A in one home, @essrt/physics computeMeanTropicalYearJ2000Days). Plan 07 R10 had already removed the phase origin's inputs (temperatureGraphMostLikely, systemResetN). Plan 11 step 2: correctionSun (the scene Sun's start angle and the perihelion-phase offset it fed — overwritten every frame by the engine-placed Sun, no display reach) and useVariableSpeed (hard-wired true in both twins: the equation of centre and the certified Moon override are the scene, not a toggle) left too. The literals gate fails if any of them returns. The K-device wheels' rates are the recorded pose block earth.kDeviceWheelPeriodYears.

earth._kDeviceInclinationPhaseNote: Plan 09 step 6: the scene scaffolding's K-device inclination-wheel phase at J2000, degrees — the J2000 perihelion longitude (102.94719°) minus the retired eccentricity law's anchor (21.77°), written as the exact double so the pose is bit-identical. Plan 11 step 2: its other readers are gone (the mean-inclination init, the perihelion wheel's offset base′, the Earth-panel cell and the About rows — every one overwritten by the engine-placed frame or a pose display); ONE reach remains, the inclination path's zodiac offset it shares with startAngleModel (the loop's angular zero, a scene literal) — it retires with that zero at step 4. The H/3 eccentricity law it once phased is deleted — Earth's e of date is the N-body series on every path.
earth._kDeviceWheelPeriodNote: Plan 09 step 7c: the scene scaffolding's K-device wheel periods in the scene's mean solar years, keyed by the wheel's index N (its identifier in the scaffold: the inclination wheel 3, the ecliptic wheel 5, the obliquity wheel 8, the axial/wobble wheel 13). Each wheel turns UNIFORMLY at its recorded J2000 rate (plan 09 step 5c) from the recorded phase kDeviceWheelPhaseAtJ2000Cycles × N; the engine places the Earth frame, the Sun and the Moon stack over the scaffold, so no observable rides them. Plan 11 step 2: the perihelion pair's wheel 16 is deleted — the engine places both perihelion nodes at the series' ϖ every frame, so its only reach was the pre-artifact first frames. Numerically the retired unit's 335,317/N, written as the exact doubles so the pose is bit-identical; they are NOT the model's precession periods (those are the dynamical values: T_p 25,771.6, the obliquity beat, the apsidal and nodal modes — the wheels read them 0.09…2 % off).
earth._kDeviceWheelPhaseNote: Plan 07 R10: the scene scaffolding's K-device wheel phase at J2000 — each wheel of index N (see kDeviceWheelPeriodYears) stands N × this turns on at J2000. Numerically the retired phase origin's (2000 − t₀)/H; kept as the device's RECORDED J2000 pose like earthtiltMean (the wheel geometry _kcFrameR bridges once), not a law. No observable rides it — the engine places the Earth frame, the Sun and the Moon stack over it — but the scene's world frame and every world-axis reader (the NASA-convention umbra diagnostic's aberration about world Y) do; measured: dropping it tilted the K pose 1.25° and moved that diagnostic 0.45″.

moon._step2Note: Plan 11 step 2: moonStartposMoon (the scene Moon's start angle — the certified series override sets the rendered Moon's direction AND distance every frame, so its only reach was the Node twin's geometric pivot) and moonMeeusLpCorrection (retired to 0 at plan 06 R3 item 1; the parameter left the lunar series) are deleted.
moon._step3Note: Plan 11 step 3: moonStartposApsidal (347.5476°) and moonStartposNodal (64.0435°) — the visible orbit RING's fitted J2000 phases (they reproduced the Meeus ϖ_Moon/Ω_Moon at the model start to 0.006°, measured on the Node twin) — are deleted. The ring's five stack layers are ENGINE-PLACED every frame from the lunar arguments (ϖ = L′ − M′, Ω = L′ − F at the scene's TT), the same arguments that place the rendered Moon and the Apsidal/Nodal markers, in both twins. The literals gate fails if either key returns.

planets._step2Note:
Plan 11 step 2: eocFraction (its only reader was an underscore field nothing set), angleCorrection (the perihelion marker's direction — overwritten by the chain placement every frame), mirrorPair (zero readers) and ascendingNodeInvPlane (the closed-form verified J2000 node — a reference derivation, moved verbatim to astro-reference planetOrbitalElements.

.ascendingNodeInvPlaneClosedForm) left each planet.
planets._step3Note: Plan 11 step 3: startpos (the scaffold's fitted start angle — its last display reach was each planet's pole azimuth and Saturn's ring plane, which turned once per orbit with the wheel; the poles are now placed from the spin channel's pole of date through the frame bridge, as Earth's axis is) and type (the scaffold wheels' ellipse family — a code taxonomy now, @essrt/physics planets/geometry SCAFFOLD_ELLIPSE_FAMILY; the perihelion-at-Earth marker's radius is the chain's a·e of date) left each planet. The literals gate fails if either returns. `name` is presentation.

_additionalBodiesNote: Plan 11 step 2: the additionalBodies block (Pluto, Halley, Eros, Ceres — scaffold angles, device inclination means/amplitudes, a stored eccentricity base and Ceres' distance override) is deleted. The four bodies are not rendered (the first three left the scene at f735c2d8; Ceres never had an object); their one live reader, the browser's angular-momentum invariable-plane check, reads the observed J2000 elements from astro-reference additionalBodiesReference (bit-identical values), and Ceres' semi-major axis is the geometry law's own Kepler value from the period. Pluto's closed-form node is astro-reference additionalBodiesReference.pluto.ascendingNodeInvPlaneClosedForm.
_perihelionPassageRefNote: Plan 11 step 3: the perihelionPassageRef block (seven phase-optimized perihelion passage JDs) is deleted with the planets' equation-of-centre branch it phased — the scaffold wheels it set are overridden by the engine-D chain for every rendered planet quantity (mesh, ring, trace, markers), so it reached nothing on screen. The literals gate fails if the block returns.
_deepTimeNote: Plan 11 step 1: the deepTime block left this file. Its fitted values (α₃, α₄, τ_GIA, the recession regime) are the banked record data/deep-time-fitted.json; α₁ is the LLR-anchored input astro-reference moonReference.moonRecessionAlpha1PerMa; the two GIA rates are DERIVED from astro-reference giaCoxChaoPeltier; the ΔT stack's taper rides its own fit artifact (data/deltaT-4flag-fit.json shipped_taper). tools/constants/generate.mjs assembles DEFAULT_CONSTANTS.deepTime from those homes; the literals gate fails if the block returns here.
